analysis.headline: Sells Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: When we engage in those activities, we sell personal information (i.e., information from cookies) to third-party advertisers and analytics companies.

analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Widely
analysis.quote: We may disclose your personal information to the following categories of recipients: to our group companies and third party services providers... with our Affiliate Partners... with third parties who facilitate log-in... with third party applications and services that integrate with Linktree... to any competent law enforcement body... to an actual or potential buyer... and to any other person with your consent.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored Internationally
analysis.quote: Your personal information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than the country in which you are a resident. These countries may have data protection laws that differ from, and in some cases may be less protective than, the laws of your country.

analysis.headline: AI Analyzes Your Social Content
analysis.quote: If you connect your Linktree account to a third-party social platform—such as Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube—we collect and process information from those accounts... We use this information to help you manage your social presence through Linktree Services, provide AI-powered insights and personalize your experience, and for other purposes described in this Privacy Notice.

analysis.headline: Monitors Your Private Communications
analysis.quote: We may undertake automatic scanning of your content—including User Profiles, links, communications (such as messages), and searches you perform—to support compliance with our Terms of Service and/or Community Standards.

analysis.headline: No Services for Under 18s
analysis.quote: Our services are not intended for use by children under the age of 18 (the “Age Limit”). If you are under the Age Limit, please do not use the Linktree Services and do not provide us with your personal information.

analysis.headline: Your Profile Is Public
analysis.quote: User profiles on Linktree are publicly accessible by default and may appear in search engine results or be indexed by third-party services.

analysis.headline: No Control Over Partners
analysis.quote: Once you interact with a third party—such as by clicking a link, subscribing to a brand’s updates, or making a purchase through a third-party link—Linktree does not control how your personal information is processed by that third party.

analysis.headline: You Receive Targeted Ads
analysis.quote: We use cookies and other tracking technologies to display advertisements to you on Linktree and on non-affiliated websites, applications, and online services. This may be considered “targeted advertising” under applicable privacy laws.

analysis.headline: Retains Data for Recruitment
analysis.quote: If your application is unsuccessful, we may retain your information on file for a maximum of two years for consideration in future opportunities.
